author: NorwegianCritic
quote: A game that used to be about escapism became a tool for the corporation to push an agenda. Im apolitical, but the fact that you can't buy prostitutes,  kill protestors or shoot up gay night clubs, while still being able to slaughter police and everyone else gives me a distaste on a fundamental level. There is no character development for the female character whatsoever. And the fact they want the main character to be a dog on a leash to the girl boss that can never make a good decision, or have any consequences for her actions, is just the final nail in the coffin. By no means a bad game, but the main story is like chewing glass cause girl boss is so unlikable. I have a real family, I don't need a needy npc to make me paint a wall, buy groceries and everything. It doesn't contribute anything good to the game. Just Rockstar HR... So disappointed.. worst pre order ever.
